skip.description: Set true ONLY to decline the item (when hint implies an unrecorded person, contradicts a record/period year, or never names the recorded main subject); otherwise false.

reason.description: Empty string "" when skip is false. When skip is true, state why in exactly one plain sentence.

class.description: Allowed values: "", "person", "contradiction", "ungrounded", "other". Must be "" when skip is false.

rows.description: Empty array [] when skip is true. Otherwise 1 row for a single, or 3 nested rows in order (rank 1 simple, rank 2 medium, rank 3 deep) for a series.

id.description: Exact row id assigned for this rank in the user message.

series.description: Exact series id assigned in the user message.

depth.description: Row depth matching rank: 1=simple, 2=medium, 3=deep (or assigned single depth).

rank.description: Allowed values: 1, 2, 3. In a 3-row series, output 1 (simple), then 2 (medium), then 3 (deep).

domain.description: Exact domain given in the user message.

genre.description: One genre for the entire series from the genre list (or two list genres combined, 'environmental portrait', or 'figure study'). Replace off-list object/topic names (animal, kylix, coin, vehicle, food, people).

records.description: Copy all given records for this rank in exact order and spelling. Total records+relations: simple 1-4 (add nothing), medium 6-14 (add 'mood feeling' and 'mood from'), deep 14-30 (keep medium's records unchanged, add 'intent purpose', 'intent for', 'story moment', and one of 'story before'/'story after'/'story cause'). Never add the assigned unknown question key or sealed values.

key.description: Two lower-case words 'system attribute' (e.g. 'mood feeling', 'shot light'). Never one word, never starting with 'rel' or 'relation', and never the assigned unknown key.

value.description: Plain lower-case words, <= 20 UTF-8 bytes, with key+value <= 27 bytes. Use closed-list values where a list exists; never use a sealed value unless copying a given record. Keep story before <= 15B and story after/cause <= 16B (2-3 plain event words).

relations.description: Keep given relations in exact order; [] if none. Each counts as 1 toward record+relation totals. Series ranks must nest relations in order.

a.description: First concrete thing/person from closed lists (never a direction, frame part, or new sealed value).

rel.description: Relation phrase from the closed relation list; a is rel of b.

b.description: Second concrete thing/person from closed lists (never a direction, frame part, or new sealed value).

thoughts.description: Critic steps about THIS picture (1-4 sentences each; no glosses, no colon labels, no spec/file talk, no advice, no invented facts, no hint copying). Counts & caps: simple 1-2 (<=8 slices, <=100B each); medium 3-5 (<=16 slices, <=330B total); deep 6-10 (<=64 slices, must include 'check' and 'compare'/'change'). Mention every record in medium/deep. Embed the exact <=20B phrase needed for any 'chain' question.

step.description: Step kind matching what the sentence does. Omit 'light' if no light record/hint exists. Deep rows require 'check' and ('compare' or 'change').

text.description: 1-4 sentences in US spelling about this picture. Hedge mood claims in ONE thought only ('suggests', 'seems', 'may', 'feels', 'reads as') and mark inferences with evidence.

wordings.description: In order by depth: simple=[caption]; medium=[caption, prompt, tags]; deep=[caption, prompt, tags, critique].

text.description: caption: 1 natural sentence naming every recorded garment+color. prompt: comma-separated recreation phrases. tags: lower-case comma-separated booru tags (thing+color, shot, medium; 1girl/1boy/1other/solo only if records agree; no mood/palette/composition/sealed words; no 'jeans' or 'from above'). critique: 1-2 craft sentences.

questions.description: Counts: simple 1-2, medium 3-5, deep 5-8 (deep must include >=1 'chain' and >=1 'unknown').

key.description: Two-word 'system attribute' spec key (or assigned 'rel1 a'/'rel1 rel'/'rel1 b' for relation record questions). For 'chain' and 'unknown', this key MUST NOT exist in this row's records.

value.description: For 'record': exact value from this row's records/relations. For 'chain': exact verbatim substring (<=20 bytes, 1-3 words, not sealed, key+value<=27B) copied word-for-word from this row's thoughts[].text. For 'unknown': must be 'unknown'.

needs.description: 'record' = key IS in this row's records/relations; 'chain' = key is NOT in records and value is stated word-for-word in thoughts; 'unknown' = assigned unknown key with value 'unknown'.
